name: Gideon
overview: The story of Gideon begins in a time when Israel had turned away from the LORD, resulting in their oppression by the Midianites. Gideon, initially threshing wheat in hiding, is called by an angel who affirms him as a 'mighty man of valor' despite his doubts and feelings of inadequacy. The LORD commissions Gideon to save Israel, emphasizing His presence and sending, even as Gideon questions the reality of God's deliverance given Israel's suffering. This narrative highlights God's sovereign call and the faith required to trust His promises amid apparent weakness and uncertainty.
